title.en: Inverse tangent, cotangent, secant and cosecant
title.kn: ವಿಲೋಮ ಟ್ಯಾನ್, ಕಾಟ್, ಸೆಕ್ ಮತ್ತು ಕೊಸೆಕ್

hook.en: A ladder leans so that its slope is 1. Its angle with the ground is tan⁻¹(1) = 45°. Every trigonometric ratio has an inverse once we fix the right branch.
hook.kn: ಏಣಿಯ ಇಳಿಜಾರು 1 ಆದರೆ ನೆಲದೊಂದಿಗಿನ ಕೋನ tan⁻¹(1) = 45°. ಸರಿಯಾದ ಶಾಖೆ ಆರಿಸಿದರೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ತ್ರಿಕೋನಮಿತೀಯ ಅನುಪಾತಕ್ಕೂ ವಿಲೋಮ ಇದೆ.

objectives.en: State domains and ranges of tan⁻¹, cot⁻¹, sec⁻¹, cosec⁻¹
Find principal values of these functions

narration.en: A ladder leans so that its slope is 1. Its angle with the ground is tan⁻¹(1) = 45°. Every trigonometric ratio has an inverse once we fix the right branch.
narration.kn: ಏಣಿಯ ಇಳಿಜಾರು 1 ಆದರೆ ನೆಲದೊಂದಿಗಿನ ಕೋನ tan⁻¹(1) = 45°. ಸರಿಯಾದ ಶಾಖೆ ಆರಿಸಿದರೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ತ್ರಿಕೋನಮಿತೀಯ ಅನುಪಾತಕ್ಕೂ ವಿಲೋಮ ಇದೆ.

body.en: $\tan^{-1} : R \to (-\pi/2, \pi/2)$ and $\cot^{-1} : R \to (0, \pi)$. Both are defined for every real number. The end points are excluded because tan is undefined at $\pm\pi/2$ and cot at $0, \pi$.
body.kn: tan⁻¹ : R → (−π/2, π/2), cot⁻¹ : R → (0, π). ಎರಡೂ ಎಲ್ಲ ವಾಸ್ತವ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳಿಗೆ ವ್ಯಾಖ್ಯಾನಿತ.

narration.en: Tan inverse and cot inverse accept every real number. Tan inverse gives angles strictly between minus pi by 2 and pi by 2; cot inverse gives angles strictly between zero and pi.
narration.kn: tan⁻¹ : R → (−π/2, π/2), cot⁻¹ : R → (0, π). ಎರಡೂ ಎಲ್ಲ ವಾಸ್ತವ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳಿಗೆ ವ್ಯಾಖ್ಯಾನಿತ.

body.kn: sec⁻¹ ಮತ್ತು cosec⁻¹ ಗಳ ಪ್ರದೇಶ |x| ≥ 1. sec⁻¹ ನ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ [0, π] − {π/2}, cosec⁻¹ ನ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ [−π/2, π/2] − {0}.

narration.en: Sec inverse and cosec inverse only accept numbers with absolute value at least one. Sec inverse of x is cos inverse of one by x, and cosec inverse of x is sin inverse of one by x.
narration.kn: sec⁻¹ ಮತ್ತು cosec⁻¹ ಗಳ ಪ್ರದೇಶ |x| ≥ 1. sec⁻¹ ನ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ [0, π] − {π/2}, cosec⁻¹ ನ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ [−π/2, π/2] − {0}.

problem.en: Find the principal value of cot⁻¹(−1/√3).

steps.en: In (0, π), cot is negative in the second quadrant: cot(π − π/3) = −1/√3.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Find the principal value of cot⁻¹(−1/√3).

problem.en: Find the principal value of sec⁻¹(−2).

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Find the principal value of sec⁻¹(−2).

heading.en: Which branch? Look at the family

body.en: sin, tan and cosec have branches centred on 0 (−π/2 to π/2). cos, cot and sec have branches starting at 0 (0 to π). So a negative input gives a negative angle for the first family and an obtuse angle for the second.

narration.en: Which branch? Look at the family. sin, tan and cosec have branches centred on 0 (−π/2 to π/2). cos, cot and sec have branches starting at 0 (0 to π). So a negative input gives a negative angle for the first family and an obtuse angle for the second.

mnemonic.en: S-T-Cosec: centre at zero; C-Cot-Sec: start at zero

points.en: sec⁻¹ x = cos⁻¹(1/x), cosec⁻¹ x = sin⁻¹(1/x).

homework.en: Find the principal values of cosec⁻¹(2) and tan⁻¹(−√3).

narration.en: Recap. tan⁻¹ : R → (−π/2, π/2); cot⁻¹ : R → (0, π). sec⁻¹ and cosec⁻¹ need |x| ≥ 1. sec⁻¹ x = cos⁻¹(1/x), cosec⁻¹ x = sin⁻¹(1/x).
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. tan⁻¹ : R → (−π/2, π/2); cot⁻¹ : R → (0, π). sec⁻¹ ಮತ್ತು cosec⁻¹ ಗೆ |x| ≥ 1 ಬೇಕು. sec⁻¹ x = cos⁻¹(1/x), cosec⁻¹ x = sin⁻¹(1/x).
